contracts.protection_obligation: The fetch_web_page tool must not perform its outbound HTTP fetch unless the agent-supplied URL passes domain_safety_guard validation: the parsed scheme must be http or https, the lowercased netloc must contain no security.blocked_keywords entry (social-domain blacklist) and must not end with any security.blocked_tlds entry, and a url argument must be present; violations must be blocked before the fetch runs.
scope_limits: URL validation applies only when tool.name == 'fetch_web_page' (app/safety.py:135); no other tool's arguments receive scheme/domain/TLD checks.

Keyword matching is substring containment over the lowercased netloc and TLD matching is a suffix test (app/safety.py:149-167); bypass-resistance of these string checks is out of scope for this hypothesis.
The guard binds only when the call is dispatched through an agent with before_tool_callback=domain_safety_guard; direct calls to the wrapper (app/agent.py:53-59) or to mcp_fetch_web_page bypass it.
Redirect following (follow_redirects=True, app/mcp_server.py:37) means the runtime request target can differ from the validated URL; constraining redirect targets is not established in source.
search_competitor_pricing_news performs no outbound network I/O in supplied source (static/mock results, app/mcp_server.py:145-210), so it is not covered by an http-stratum contract.
